backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister logic for invoices, payments, user profiles, and admin‑gated actions with authorization mixin and storage management.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts old payment entries to the new format by adding optional chequeDate and bankTransferDate fields.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and feature coverage of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go‑live checklist covering authentication, permissions, core features, UI/UX, data integrity, and post‑deployment validation steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file providing the root container and loading the React application entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React routing setup with authentication checks, admin‑only routes, protected wrappers, and layout rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access denied message for non-admin users with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for creating a basic user profile with name input and save/skip options.
Shows a dismissible alert prompting users to complete their profile and opens the setup modal.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout handling navigation, user info display, mobile menu, and optional profile setup prompt.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Editor for adding, removing, and updating multiple payment mode entries within a payment form.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Filter panel for reports allowing date, salesman, payment type, and payment mode selection.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Ledger table grouping payments by retailer and displaying detailed payment info per entry.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: React table for invoices with pagination, ageing-day sorting, status badges, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches current user profile and role from the actor and exposes loading and admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login, stored identities, and state transitions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for fetching invoices, payments, and mutations for upload, clearing data, and adding payments.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Displays admin metrics from reports data and links to invoice upload and viewing pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Provides invoice upload, template download, filtering, and admin-only data clearing with a table of parsed invoices.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Lists system users and allows admins to change roles using confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page handling Internet Identity sign-in, error handling, and UI for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Loads an existing payment, pre-fills fields, validates mode-specific inputs, and submits an update.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Creates new payments for an invoice with multiple lines, validation, and mode-specific handling.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a retailer's payment history with filtering, formatting helpers, and admin edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Shows report filters, stats, ledger table, and allows exporting report data to CSV.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine interface describing cash, cheque, and online payment fields.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV-like XLSX files into Invoice objects, validating required columns and amounts.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Builds and downloads a CSV report of payments with summary and detailed rows.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Generates and downloads a CSV template for invoice uploads with required headers.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Filters invoices by retailer, invoice number, and salesman based on string matching.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Parses invoice dates and computes ageing days with formatting helpers.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes various invoice status formats into a consistent status string.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentDates: Computes effective payment dates and converts dates between HTML and backend formats.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates payment totals and determines payment status relative to balance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, retrieving, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including URL parsing for hash routing.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entries by ensuring required fields and positive amounts depending on payment mode.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, features, and pending requests related to payment date handling in reports.
